claims.statement: Industrial rotating machinery RMS velocity is evaluated across 10 Hz - 1000 Hz per ISO 20816-1 / ISO 10816-3 [SRC-1].
Synchronous 4-channel acquisition at 10 kHz preserves anti-aliased bearing harmonics (BPFO, BPFI) with Hanning amplitude correction [SRC-3].
Single-plane vector balancing computes Wc = -V0 / A computationally while flagging physical mass attachment as NOT VERIFIED without lockout/tagout [SRC-2].
